lifeEvents: Your back has filed for early retirement.
A pipe burst. It was load-bearing.
Chronic illness. The Ministry requires you to prove it is chronic by waiting.
Workplace accident. The workplace has been notified and is fine.
Your car was hit while parked. The other driver has submitted Form 27-B: Proof of Innocence, in triplicate.
A storm took your roof. The Ministry has opened a ticket. Your ticket number is 9.
A hospital stay. The bill arrived before you did.
Your knee made a noise. A specialist confirmed the noise for a fee.
A flood reached the second floor. The flood insurance office is on the first floor.
A long illness in the family. The leave policy is in a binder nobody can find.
Your teeth have unionized and are demanding a crown.
A fire in the kitchen. The smoke detector would like it noted that it tried.
A sudden diagnosis. The Ministry requests the diagnosis be resubmitted on the correct form.
Your landlord sold the building to a holding company named after a tree.

l1.P1: LET THEM EAT AVERAGE. Citizens with 160 coins describe the result as 'fair, actually.'
NO TAX ADOPTED. Ministry saves on paperwork, loses on everything else.
AVERAGE MAXIMIZED. The average citizen is thrilled. The average citizen does not exist.
MARKET LEFT ALONE. Market thanks citizens, asks to be left alone further.
l1.P2: SAFETY NET ADOPTED. Floor set at 40 coins. Ministry checks the floor for termites.
NOBODY BELOW FORTY. Ministry calls it 'a reasonable minimum.' Minimum calls it 'a start.'
NET DEPLOYED AT {t}% TAX. Citizens debate whether a net counts as a floor.
SAFETY NET PASSES. Tightrope walkers' union issues cautious statement of support.
l1.P3: RANGE CAP ADOPTED. Richest citizen now only modestly richer. Richest citizen files complaint.
INEQUALITY CAPPED AT 100 COINS. Ministry measures it with a ruler.
GAP SHRUNK BY DECREE. Gap reportedly 'feeling smaller, emotionally.'
RANGE CAP AT {t}% TAX. Statisticians thrilled. Everyone else asks what a range is.
l1.P4: MAXIMIN ADOPTED. Everyone equally disappointed. Ministry calls it 'a triumph of solidarity.'
WORST-OFF CITIZEN NOW SLIGHTLY LESS WORST. Tax rate hits {t}%. Leaky bucket reports record leaks.
RAWLS WINS. Ministry orders a portrait. Portrait is taxed at {t}%.
MAXIMIN PASSES. The poorest citizen is the richest poorest citizen in history.
l1.tie: The Supreme Court has flipped a coin.
Vote tied. The Supreme Court has flipped a coin. The coin declined to comment.
Deadlock broken by coin toss. The Ministry calls it 'democracy, in a way.'
The Supreme Court has flipped a coin. Best of three was ruled unconstitutional.
l2.highTax: Citizens discover leisure. GDP files missing-person report.
TAX AT {t}%. Effort spotted leaving the Republic with a small suitcase.
HIGH TAX ERA BEGINS. Ministry reports record equality and record napping.
{t}% TAX ADOPTED. Economists predict disaster, then ask for a grant to study it.
l2.lucky: {name} earns a fortune. Credits hard work. Hard work declines to confirm.
LUCKIEST CITIZEN THANKS HUSTLE. Hustle was not consulted.
{name} tops the income table. Luck draw was 'merely a factor,' says {name}.
{name} strikes it rich. Ministry opens inquiry into whether the dice were self-made.
l2.zeroTax: ZERO TAX ROUND. Ministry staff paid in compliments.
NO REDISTRIBUTION. Everyone keeps what they earn and also what they were dealt.
TAX-FREE REPUBLIC. The richest citizen gives a TED talk about it.
ZERO PERCENT. Ministry sells a chair to cover lunch.
l2.normal: TAX SET AT {t}%. Median voter satisfied. Everyone else is the median voter's problem.
MODERATE TAX ADOPTED. Moderates celebrate moderately.
{t}% TAX. Ministry calls it 'balanced.' Nobody checked the balance.
MEDIAN VOTER WINS AGAIN. Median voter asks to remain anonymous.
l3.exit: SafeHands Mutual exits market, cites 'customers who actually need insurance.'
INSURER LEAVES. SafeHands Mutual has pivoted to cryptocurrency.
NO BUYERS. SafeHands Mutual closes its doors and its sympathy.
MARKET FOR PROTECTION DISSOLVES. Protection unavailable for comment.
l3.premiumUp: PREMIUM RISES TO {premium} COINS. SafeHands Mutual blames 'the kind of people who buy insurance.'
SafeHands Mutual raises prices. Actuaries describe this year as 'last year, but worse.'
COST OF PROTECTION CLIMBS. Healthy citizens decide they feel lucky.
PREMIUM UP. SafeHands Mutual thanks its remaining customers, whom it now suspects.
l3.mandatory: MANDATE IN EFFECT. Everyone is covered. Everyone is also billed.
SOCIAL INSURANCE ROUND. The Ministry reviewed your gym receipts personally.
COVERAGE FOR ALL. Healthy citizens grumble, then trip over a curb.
MANDATORY POOL OPERATES. Adverse selection reported missing, presumed fine.
l3.manyEvents: {events} LIFE EVENTS THIS ROUND. Ministry forms department to process the forms.
BAD ROUND FOR LUCK. The uninsured learn about deductibles from the other side.
MISFORTUNE SPREADS. Ministry issues reminder that misfortune is not a lifestyle choice.
MULTIPLE CLAIMS FILED. Claims department asks for a quieter apocalypse.
l3.quiet: QUIET ROUND. Nothing bad happened. Insurers call it 'a great year.'
NO NEWS IS GOOD NEWS. The uninsured feel very smart today.
CALM ROUND. The gym reports record attendance and record lying.
UNEVENTFUL. Premium payers wonder what they paid for. That is how it works.
l4.squareComplex: HireBot 3000 surprised. Updates beliefs by {delta}. Calls it 'a lot.'
A SQUARE GETS A COMPLEX JOB. HireBot runs diagnostics. Diagnostics say 'fine.'
STEREOTYPE DENTED. HireBot now believes {pi} of Squares are skilled. Up from somewhat less.
HIREBOT PROMOTES A SQUARE. HireBot insists it was always open to this.
l4.noSquare: NO SQUARES IN COMPLEX JOBS. HireBot reminds everyone it does not see color, only data.
HIREBOT REPORT: Squares remain 'statistically unremarkable.' Squares remain unhired.
THE ALGORITHM IS NEUTRAL, says the algorithm. Squares note the outcome is not.
SQUARE SKILL ESTIMATE NOW {pi}. HireBot calls the data 'very convincing.' It wrote the data.
l4.policy_B: BLIND HIRING IN EFFECT. HireBot wears a blindfold. HireBot peeks only at averages.
HireBot can no longer see shapes. HireBot reports feeling 'liberated and confused.'
BLIND HIRING ROUND. Everyone is now judged by the average of everyone.
SHAPES HIDDEN. HireBot asks if it can at least see the color. It cannot.
l4.policy_C: QUOTA ROUND. HireBot hires as instructed. HireBot learns nothing, as instructed.
THE QUOTA HOLDS. Squares get Complex jobs. Investment in skill stays suspiciously low.
QUOTA FILLED. HireBot files Form 44-Q: Hiring Under Protest.
QUOTA ENFORCED. Ministry calls it fairness. Economists call it 'a patronizing equilibrium.'
l4.policy_D: SUBSIDIZED CHILDCARE ROUND. The office printer has been relieved of parenting duties.
CHILDCARE FUNDED. Caregivers can now choose long hours without chaos, or at least with less chaos.
GREEDY JOBS NOW SLIGHTLY LESS GREEDY. Children report fewer printer-based meals.
CHILDCARE SUBSIDY IN EFFECT. The kids are alright. The budget is fine-ish.
l5.passedDonations: Constitution amended. Ministry confirms no money changed hands, except the money that changed hands.
AMENDMENT PASSES AFTER GENEROUS GIFTS. Generosity and timing found to be unrelated, says donor.
NEW CONSTITUTION ADOPTED: {t}% TAX, FLOOR {F}. Lobbyists describe the process as 'very democratic.'
REFORM PASSES. Ministry ethics office is reviewing the snacks.
l5.passed: CONSTITUTION AMENDED. Delegates rediscover their principles now that they know their incomes.
AMENDMENT PASSES: TAX NOW {t}%, FLOOR {F}. The veil is lifted and so are some eyebrows.
THE RULES CHANGE. Everyone agrees the new rules are fairer, for them.
NEW SETTLEMENT REACHED. Rawls could not be reached for comment.
l5.failed: ALL AMENDMENTS FAIL. The supermajority requirement does its one job.
CONSTITUTION SURVIVES CONTACT WITH SELF-INTEREST. Barely.
AMENDMENTS DEFEATED. Delegates who lost blame 'the system.' The system says hi.
NO CHANGE. The veil constitution stands at {t}% tax, floor {F}. Several delegates look betrayed by their past selves.
l5.noAmendments: NO AMENDMENTS PROPOSED. Delegates either very principled or very tired.
THE VEIL CONSTITUTION STANDS. The Ministry suspects a misprint.
NOBODY AMENDS ANYTHING. Ministry confused, slightly moved.
CONSTITUTION RATIFIED AS WRITTEN. Historians will call this 'unusual.'
